Do you experience bloating, acidity, gas or heaviness even when you eat home-cooked, nutritious meals? The way you prepare, combine and eat certain foods may influence how comfortable you feel after a meal. Ayurveda offers the traditional concept of Viruddha Ahara, which describes food combinations considered incompatible.
In this video, Hansaji explains food-combining basics through traditional Ayurvedic principles and practical Indian meal examples.
You will learn:
1. Why Ayurveda traditionally advises against combining milk with sour or citrus fruits.
